title: The Perfect Autopsy
author: Noor Brightwater
blurb: Cyrus Reyes, an insurance investigator with a photographic memory, thought they had seen every way a life can end. Then a body turns up dressed in clothes stolen from the witness's own closet — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do before the statute expires.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
